name: OptiObra Full Stack
author: OptiObra Team
description: Sistema de gestion de construccion con Backend Django y Frontend Angular. Incluye MySQL Server dentro del contenedor y soporte para tuneles de Cloudflare (cloudflared).

config.startup: {"done": "OptiObra is up and running", "backend": "Starting gunicorn", "nginx": "start worker processes"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OptiObra Installation Script

# Create directories
mkdir -p /home/container/models
mkdir -p /home/container/backend/media
mkdir -p /home/container/logs

# Install system dependencies
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates gnupg

# Download LLM model if MODEL_URL is provided
if [ -n "${MODEL_URL:-}" ]; then
  MODEL_FILE="/home/container/models/llama-3.2-1b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf"
  if [ ! -f "$MODEL_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Downloading LLM model..."
    curl -L --fail --progress-bar -o "$MODEL_FILE" "$MODEL_URL"
    chmod 644 "$MODEL_FILE"
  else
    echo "Model already exists, skipping download."
  fi
fi

# Set permissions
chown -R 1000:1000 /home/container/models
chown -R 1000:1000 /home/container/backend/media
chown -R 1000:1000 /home/container/logs

echo "Installation completed."

variables.description: Usuario de la base de datos MySQL interna.

variables.description: Contrasena de la base de datos MySQL interna.

variables.description: Clave secreta de Django. Cambiala en produccion.

variables.description: Modo debug de Django. Desactivalo en produccion.

variables.description: Hosts permitidos separados por comas. Incluye el dominio del frontend y el del API.
